origins.section: A Row Leaves Each Variable Only What the Others Must Use
A Clique of Conflicts Is One Valid Row, Stronger Than Its Pairs
A Derived Row Is Trusted Only After It Is Checked Against Whole Plans

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-room: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-room: Floor = M1's 4 + M2's smallest use 0 = 4, so room = 10 − 4 = 6. "If a_u is more than the room, no allowed plan can set x_u = 1", and 7 > 6.
recorded.prompt:q-clique: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-clique: "the point with every start of a five-start clique at 0.5 satisfies all ten pair rows and gives the clique row 2.5". At 0.4 each, a pair sums to 0.8 ≤ 1 and the clique row to 1.6 > 1.
recorded.prompt:q-check: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-check: "The optimum only tests the plans near the top. A wrong row that cuts off a plan worth less than the best one would leave the optimum unchanged."

recorded.prompt:q-room:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:a: The comparison is with the room ("b minus the floor"), not the full capacity.
recorded.prompt:q-room:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:b: The floor already takes M2's "smallest of its starts' uses" (0). M1's 4 still leaves only 6.
recorded.prompt:q-room:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:d: The page's tightening only fixes at 0, and here the start does not fit: "tightens from [0, 1] to [0, 0]".
recorded.prompt:q-clique:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clique:b: The clique row is the sum of all four variables, 1.6, not 0.4. Each pair sums to 0.8 ≤ 1, so the pair rows hold. Same pairs-hold/clique-breaks pattern as the 0.5 example.
recorded.prompt:q-clique:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clique:c: "the pair rows do not imply it". The clique row sums to 1.6 > 1, so it is broken.
recorded.prompt:q-clique:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clique:d: Same 0.5 example: the fractional point "satisfies all ten pair rows". At 0.4 each, a pair sums to 0.8.
recorded.prompt:q-check:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:a: Same passage: a wrong row can cut off a worse plan and "leave the optimum unchanged and still be wrong."
recorded.prompt:q-check:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:c: An unchanged optimum doesn't show the rows are even valid (same passage). The fixings kept the optimum, yet "The LP bound falls by $92.16k", so they weren't redundant.
recorded.prompt:q-check:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:d: The rows kept the optimum and still lowered the LP bound: "fixings + cliques... LP bound 24,580.01" against 25,170.51. They do work.
